text:
sarah: FYI customer report — streaming response from Redwood Node/edge SDK stalls in Vercel Edge runtime after token rotation. They see the stream stop yielding chunks, no error, client stays waiting. Trying to repro now but wanted to check if anyone has seen this pattern. Attached small log snippet below.

mike: Which SDK version and Next/Vercel runtime? Also: are you using response.body.getReader() or for-await-of on the stream?

sarah: Using @redwood/inference-js v0.10.4 (edge build), Next.js edge API route (experimental edge). Client does for-await-of on response.body (ReadableStream) and reads TextDecoder chunks. Code pattern: 

```js
// inside edge route
const res = await inference.client.stream({ /* prompt */ });
for await (const chunk of res.body) {
  // push to SSE or chunk aggregator
}
```

sarah: Logs show normal chunks, then after ~30s when token refresh hits we stop getting further chunks. No 4xx/5xx from Redwood; connection not closed, client shows no error.

mike: Can you paste the debug output (set REDWOOD_SDK_LOG=debug) around the time it stalls? Also is the customer using automatic token rotation (short-lived key) or proxying auth?

sarah: They rotate tokens from their auth service (short-lived signed token). Debug log: 

```
[DEBUG] 2026-02-14T12:18:23Z outgoing chunk len=512
[DEBUG] 2026-02-14T12:18:33Z outgoing chunk len=256
[DEBUG] 2026-02-14T12:18:54Z token refresh requested
[DEBUG] 2026-02-14T12:18:54Z auth: swapped token, retrying request
[DEBUG] 2026-02-14T12:18:54Z connection: resumed
[DEBUG] 2026-02-14T12:19:20Z no new chunks for 26s, client waiting
```

sarah: No explicit network error shown. They say switching to non-edge (Node server runtime) fixes it.

raj: This sounds like the edge-runtime streaming polyfill + auth swap interaction. We saw a regression where aborts/stream resets during a token rotation left the ReadableStream locked in a pending state. It was introduced in 0.10.3 and fixed in 0.10.5, but 0.10.4 had a bad shim for getReader() edge case.

mike: If the customer can, ask them to try pinning to v0.10.2 or upgrade to 0.10.5 (if available) — we should confirm which release they can easily run. Also ask them to try using the SDK option disableAutoRetry: true to avoid an in-flight reconnect on auth refresh as a quick workaround.

sarah: I asked them to try 0.10.2 and to set REDWOOD_SDK_LOG=debug; customer already confirmed 0.10.2 works for them. They can't easily upgrade to 0.10.5 yet (blocked by internal changes).

raj: OK. Short-term mitigation: disable auto-retry on auth error OR perform token rotation outside of an active streaming session (rotate then open stream). For longer-term, engineering will backport the fix into a patch for 0.10.4 if necessary.

mike: Can you capture a minimal repro repo that runs on Vercel edge? If we have a small NextJS route that reproduces we can run in CI. Also include a HAR (if possible) and the full debug log.

sarah: Will request minimal repro and a short recording. In the meantime, adding a note to the support response: "Temporary workaround: pin SDK to 0.10.2 or disable auto-retry during streaming; schedule upgrade to patched release when available." :thumbsup:

infra-bot: Deployment note — created internal issue: https://github.com/redwood-internal/inference/issues/1421 assigned to @raj (eng-runtime).

raj: Thanks. I'll prioritize a backport if customer is enterprise and needs a patched minor. If not, recommend migration path notes and add an FAQ entry for token-rotation + edge streaming.

customer: Confirmed pinned to 0.10.2 and disabling auto-retry resolved stalls for now. Thanks, team.

mike: Great — Marking as support-escalated -> eng-runtime. Keep me updated if they can test 0.10.5 when ready.

sarah: Will update ticket with repro and logs.
